The likely cause is the account code. The stored ACCT_CD is char(8) with padding, and the first attempt sent "5300    " (padded), which matches the stored form. The verifier may instead compare on a trimmed code, or it may take the account codes "as stored in the ledger" literally. The dr_amt and cr_amt were also passed as strings ("0.00" and "18.00"), which may not have been parsed as numbers.

Another possibility is that the check ties the invoice to the journal on the AP credit side or the debit total, and my correction already satisfies both. So the most plausible fixes are the amount types and the account code format. I'll resubmit with numeric amounts and the account code exactly as stored, and keep the line to 18.00 in period 11.
